# 4ENG

> 4ENG is an AI execution platform for engineering firms. It connects a shared engineering model, tested production skills and governed human review so approved requirements become reviewed deliverables: loop drawings, panel general arrangements, control packages, proposals and handover evidence.

## Status
- In active development (October 2026). Drawing and multidiscipline workflows are proposed capabilities validated with design partners before release.
- Observed today: 24 draft skill packages, 12 test-mode runs, two pilots (technical proposal DOCX/PDF drafts; offline controller configuration candidates).

## Key ideas
- A drawing is a view; the asset (stable object identity) is the intelligence.
- A skill is a tested production method: input contract, approved knowledge, executable tools, acceptance evidence.
- AI proposes, engineering tools execute, qualified people authorize. No inferred certification.
- Change impact: an approved change marks affected deliverables stale and routes review; it never overwrites issued work.

## Audience
Automation and systems integration firms, engineering service teams and equipment builders with 50 to 500 people.
